capabilities: Render text and emoji progress bars from text-progress-bar code blocks
Customize filled, empty, and transition characters
Use decimals to show partial completion on emoji bars
Group multiple progress bars in a single block with labels
extras: Manual installation only; the README does not mention a community plugin store listing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize numeric completion as simple text bars within notes.
summary: Code-block renderer that draws text-based and emoji progress bars inside notes, with configurable characters and grouping.
